license_required.quote: No person shall practice or attempt to practice podiatry or hold himself or herself out as being able to do so in this State without first having obtained a license under this chapter.

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Medical Practice established by chapter 23 of this title.

age_minimum.quote: have attained the age of majority

degree_required.value: diploma or certificate of graduation from an accredited school of podiatric medicine
degree_required.quote: have received a diploma or certificate of graduation from an accredited school of podiatric medicine approved by the Board

accrediting_body.quote: accredited school of podiatric medicine approved by the Board

required.quote: A graduate of a U.S. or Canadian podiatric school accredited by a body that is acceptable to the Board shall have successfully completed at least two years of postgraduate training in a U.S. or Canadian program accredited by an organization that is acceptable to the Board

duration.value: at least two years (U.S./Canadian graduates) or at least three years (non-U.S./Canadian graduates)
duration.quote: shall have successfully completed at least two years of postgraduate training in a U.S. or Canadian program accredited by an organization that is acceptable to the Board

kind.quote: successfully completed at least two years of postgraduate training in a U.S. or Canadian program accredited by an organization that is acceptable to the Board

exams.name: National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners
exams.notes: All required steps as set forth by the Board by rule
exams.quote: successfully complete all required steps of the examinations given by the National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners, as set forth by the Board by rule

interval_years.quote: A person licensed by the Board to practice podiatry shall apply biennially for the renewal of his or her license.

available.quote: A person who is licensed under the laws of another jurisdiction and who desires licensure as a podiatrist without examination shall apply to the Board in writing on a form furnished by it and pay the specified fee.

requirements.value: The Board shall license the person if it deems that person has met requirements in the other jurisdiction substantially equal to those of this State; or via endorsement process requiring not more than three years of practice in good standing in another U.S. jurisdiction plus postgraduate training requirements.
requirements.quote: The Board shall have an endorsement process for podiatrist licensure that requires not more than three years of practice in good standing in another jurisdiction within the United States, regardless of whether that jurisdiction has licensing requirements substantially equal to those of this State

definition_quote.value: "Practice of podiatry," by a podiatric physician, means any medical, mechanical, surgical, electrical, manipulation, strapping, or bandaging treatment of the ailments pertaining to the human foot and lower leg distal to the myotendinous junction of the triceps surae.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of podiatry," by a podiatric physician, means any medical, mechanical, surgical, electrical, manipulation, strapping, or bandaging treatment of the ailments pertaining to the human foot and lower leg distal to the myotendinous junction of the triceps surae.

methods_authorized.quote: any medical, mechanical, surgical, electrical, manipulation, strapping, or bandaging treatment of the ailments pertaining to the human foot and lower leg distal to the myotendinous junction of the triceps surae

drug_authority.value: Controlled substances may be administered, dispensed, or prescribed only as authorized by law
drug_authority.quote: administering, dispensing, or prescribing any controlled substance other than as authorized by law

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: treatment of the ailments pertaining to the human foot and lower leg distal to the myotendinous junction of the triceps surae

amputation_authorized.quote: In the case of amputations other than toe amputations and in the case of surgical treatment at or above the ankle, the surgical treatment shall be performed only in a general hospital licensed under 18 V.S.A. chapter 43 or a certified ambulatory surgical center

anesthesia_authority.quote: If spinal or general anesthesia is required, it shall be administered by a health care professional regulated under this title who is authorized to administer anesthesia within the scope of his or her practice.

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: in the case of surgical treatment at or above the ankle, the surgical treatment shall be performed only in a general hospital licensed under 18 V.S.A. chapter 43 or a certified ambulatory surgical center

ankle_surgery_facility_requirement.quote: the surgical treatment shall be performed only in a general hospital licensed under 18 V.S.A. chapter 43 or a certified ambulatory surgical center as defined in 18 V.S.A. § 9432
